questions.question: The source calls Jacob a pupil of Johann, Nicholas I and Paul Euler, although it may intend to say their teacher. Please confirm the intended relationship. The English retains the literal pupil claim.

The source attributes every mathematical item in the first eponym list, including Bernoulli’s differential equation, to Jacob. Please verify whether this needs individual attribution, particularly to Johann. The supplied attribution is preserved.
